name: Buttercup
description: Buttercup's desktop updater checks the buttercup-desktop GitHub feed about every 30 minutes, leaves electron-updater auto-retrieval disabled until the user starts a retrieval, and installs a retrieved update through the install action. Release scripts publish SHA-512 metadata and invoke a Windows signing hook; this review does not establish application-pinned runtime verification.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; electron-updater dependency internals and release-specific signing credentials are outside this tree.
Metadata generation and a signing hook do not establish independent runtime verification of the downloaded artifact.
